issues.quote: I suddenly picture the green yard, which has already swallowed up my room.
There iron chains clank and dogs bark furiously.
their long shaggy wool leaps with them
A fury, all teeth, strains and cannot quite burst out of the deep maw, and only tosses up a haystack of wool.
it throttles you by the throat and drives your fiery rage back down into it
Well, stand still, don't fidget, until they take the chain off you... and now go on.
and off she tears without a thought, blind

strengths.quote: It strikes with a little hammer on a great crystal bell, cuckoo! cuckoo! and sows silence over the grass.
Red eyes leap, a broad forehead leaps, and white furry leggings.
strengths.why: the dog bounding, seen in pieces

strengths.quote: Ah, what a trifle that is! What a trifle, if only you knew...
strengths.why: hints at the narrator's hidden pain

strengths.quote: She rips up the grass with her claws, flings it behind her, and the matted tufts on her hindquarters fly after her.
